paragraphs: Rav Hamnuna, son of Rav Adda bar Ahavah. Midrash Kohelet, on “The sun rises”: on the day Rav Adda bar Ahavah died, his son Rav Hamnuna was born; on the day Rav Hamnuna died, his son Rabbi Avin was born. But Bereshit Rabbah says, “On the day Rav Hamnuna died Rabbi Avin was born,” without the word “his son.”
